about: A dashed trend line across a scatter: the least-squares line through the points, over the range of x the points cover. linearRegression returns the line's r², which the page states and reads to decide whether the line belongs on the chart.

channels.about: Each series takes a RegressionOverlay with series set to its key. Each line takes its series' color, hides while the legend hides the series, and fades while the legend points at the other series.
channels.caption: Online, each euro on the price costs about {{online}} units a week. In store, it costs about {{store}}.
channels.label: Weekly units by price and channel
channels.title: Trend line per series

fit.about: A RegressionOverlay child of a ScatterPlot fits the fourteen products. The line runs from the cheapest product to the dearest and no further, dashed in the neutral palette's chart color.
fit.caption: Each euro on the price costs about {{units}} units a week, with an r² of {{r2}}.
fit.label: Weekly units by price
fit.title: Trend line

narrow.about: The fitted products in a room 20rem wide, the column of a phone.
narrow.title: Narrow room

title: Regression overlay

weak.about: The page reads r² from linearRegression and renders the overlay only at 0.5 or more. A straight line through a cloud like this one would picture a relationship the data does not show.
weak.caption: Team size accounts for {{share}} of the variance in weekly deploys, so the page shows no trend line.
weak.label: Weekly deploys by team size
weak.title: Weak fit
